name: waypoint-realtime-gateway
description: waypoint-realtime-gateway tooling: 9 wp-rt-* agents (connection, relay and presence builders plus read-only security, performance and architecture reviewers for the WebSocket gateway, plus a .github maintainer), 10 /wp-* commands, 9 path-scoped rules, 14 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-realtime-gateway checkout.
